_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

The Worm Holes#000.src: New Questline Started: The Realm of Light
The Worm Holes#000.dst: 新しいクエストライン開始: 光の領域

The Worm Holes#001.src: Find out what's going on at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Worm Holes#001.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で何が起きているか調べる

The Worm Holes#002.src: Arrighty fellers, let's get this wrapped up now! 'ere's plenty more holes where this one came from!
The Worm Holes#002.dst: よーし野郎ども、ここらで片付けちまうぞ！穴ならまだ山ほどあるんだからな！
The Worm Holes#002.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#004.src: The scaffolds are crackin'! Everyone, get offa there, now!!
The Worm Holes#004.dst: 足場が割れてる！全員、今すぐそこから降りろ！！
The Worm Holes#004.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#006.src: Aw, hell... I knew this project was a bust from the start...there goes Willam and Clint cause a' this!
The Worm Holes#006.dst: ちくしょう…この仕事は最初からダメだと思ってたんだ…Willam と Clint がこのせいで…！
The Worm Holes#006.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#007.src: I gotta get someone tough enough to get down there...hm? Hey, a human! Git on over here!
The Worm Holes#007.dst: 下まで行ける頑丈な奴を探さねえと…ん？おい、人間じゃねえか！こっち来い！
The Worm Holes#007.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#008.src: I gotta ask, how much 'a that didja see, Wynn feller? Wasn't pretty, and I'm in charge a' them folks, so I gotta take responsibility fer that.
The Worm Holes#008.dst: 聞くが、今のをどれくらい見た、Wynn の兄ちゃん？ひでえもんだったろ。あいつらは俺の部下だ、責任は俺が取らなきゃならねえ。
The Worm Holes#008.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#009.src: Th' mayor of {p} there saw these holes poppin' up, and hired us out to cover 'em up. Thing is, the ground's too unstable to build.
The Worm Holes#009.dst: あそこの {p} の村長が穴が次々空くのを見て、埋めるために俺らを雇ったんだ。だが地盤がゆるすぎて何も建てられねえ。
The Worm Holes#009.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#010.src: It's gettin' real worrying round here. They only started openin' up recently, and there've been quakes too. Feels like the place is gonna collapse!
The Worm Holes#010.dst: この辺りはどんどん物騒になってる。穴が開き始めたのはつい最近で、地震まで起きてる。この土地ごと崩れそうだ！
The Worm Holes#010.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#011.src: I think we oughta head down there and figure out what 'n heck's goin' on, and you're the best armed outta any of us, being human 'n all.
The Worm Holes#011.dst: 下へ行って何が起きてんのか突き止めるべきだと思う。で、人間のあんたが俺らの中で一番いい装備してるってわけだ。
The Worm Holes#011.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#012.src: Think y'all could head down 'n see if you can rustle up any leads? There's a path down just to the left of the hole.
The Worm Holes#012.dst: 下りて手がかりを探してきてくれねえか？穴のすぐ左に下りる道がある。
The Worm Holes#012.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#013.src: Go down the hole and look for what's causing this and return to Malo at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with proof.
The Worm Holes#013.dst: 穴に下りて原因を探り、証拠を持って [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Malo の所へ戻る。

The Worm Holes#014.src: What in tarnation...? The heck did you find down there, soldier?
The Worm Holes#014.dst: なんてこった…？下で何を見つけてきたんだ、兵隊さん？
The Worm Holes#014.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#015.src: Oh, it was just the skin, huh? Dang...was hopin' you'd've seen what it was, cause I got no clue 'bout this.
The Worm Holes#015.dst: ああ、ただの皮か？くそ…何なのか見てきてくれりゃと思ったんだがな、俺にはさっぱりだ。
The Worm Holes#015.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#016.src: Urgh. Only gal I know who might have an idea 'bout this is that durn elf lady...
The Worm Holes#016.dst: うーん。こいつが分かりそうなのは、あのいまいましいエルフの姉ちゃんくらいだ…
The Worm Holes#016.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#017.src: She's got purple hair and's been wanderin' round like she knows everything. Yeah, she's a bright penny but she ain't gotta be so uppity ta all of us 'bout it.
The Worm Holes#017.dst: 紫の髪で、何でも知ってるって顔でうろついてる。まあ頭はいいんだが、俺らにそこまで偉そうにしなくてもいいだろうに。
The Worm Holes#017.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#018.src: She put up a camp just east of here. She'll prob'ly react better to you than me, so I'll go to the authorities and see if they have any leads.
The Worm Holes#018.dst: ここのすぐ東に野営してる。俺よりあんたの方が話を聞いてもらえるだろう。俺はお役所に行って手がかりがないか聞いてくる。
The Worm Holes#018.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#019.src: Look for Lari and ask what is going on at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Worm Holes#019.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Lari を探し、何が起きているか尋ねる

The Worm Holes#020.src: ...Haven’t we met? I have witnessed your presence in Gavel more than once.
The Worm Holes#020.dst: …以前お会いしましたね？Gavel であなたの姿を何度か見かけました。
The Worm Holes#020.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#021.src: I am Lari. I might have greeted you properly before if I were not so busy, which reminds me. You have a reason to be here, yes?
The Worm Holes#021.dst: 私は Lari。これほど忙しくなければ、以前きちんとご挨拶できたのですが…そういえば。ここに来たのには理由があるのでしょう？
The Worm Holes#021.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#022.src: Hm...I believe I know what you have found, by your description. That dead skin too, is proof enough, I would say.
The Worm Holes#022.dst: ふむ…お話からすると、見つけたものの正体は分かります。その抜け殻も十分な証拠でしょう。
The Worm Holes#022.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#023.src: The creature which shed that skin is known as a Grootslang. Though large, they are rather peaceful. Gentle giants, I believe the saying is?
The Worm Holes#023.dst: その皮を脱いだ生き物は Grootslang といいます。大きいけれど、とても穏やかです。「気は優しくて力持ち」、でしたか？
The Worm Holes#023.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#024.src: This horrid Decay...it affects their habitats underground. They are seeking shelter closer to the surface. I have been trying to scrub the Decay without success...
The Worm Holes#024.dst: この恐ろしい腐朽が…地下の棲みかを侵しているのです。彼らは地表近くへ逃れてきている。私は腐朽を払おうとしてきましたが、うまくいかず…
The Worm Holes#024.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#025.src: Wait... More holes appeared just today? There...there were deaths?! W-where, when?!
The Worm Holes#025.dst: 待って…今日また穴が？そこで…死者が出たの！？ど、どこで、いつ！？
The Worm Holes#025.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#026.src: No, no...! I refuse to be responsible for any more deaths... Human, tell me your name, please.
The Worm Holes#026.dst: だめ、だめ…！これ以上の死の責任は負えない…人間さん、どうか名前を教えて。
The Worm Holes#026.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#027.src: {u}, then... Let us head to the site. {u}. I need to fix this... Please, help me get to the root of this problem so I may soothe the land's pain.
The Worm Holes#027.dst: {u}、ですね…現場へ向かいましょう。{u}。私が何とかしないと…どうか、土地の痛みを癒せるよう、問題の根源を突き止めるのを手伝って。
The Worm Holes#027.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#028.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Lari と合流する

The Worm Holes#029.src: So this is the site... [Gavellian Spell]...
The Worm Holes#029.dst: ここが現場ですね…[Gavellian Spell]…
The Worm Holes#029.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#030.src: Here. Allow me to provide at least one person safe passage into the pit.
The Worm Holes#030.dst: さあ。せめて一人だけでも、安全に穴の底へ送らせて。
The Worm Holes#030.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#031.src: Have faith- Jump in. I will carry you down slowly.
The Worm Holes#031.dst: 信じて―飛び込んで。ゆっくり下ろしてあげます。
The Worm Holes#031.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#032.src: Take the lead. If we can find any further evidence of the Grootslangs around here, it will aid in my understanding.
The Worm Holes#032.dst: 先に進んで。この辺りで Grootslang の痕跡がもっと見つかれば、理解の助けになります。
The Worm Holes#032.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#033.src: Hm? This wall looks like it's been disturbed recently...
The Worm Holes#033.dst: ん？この壁、最近掘り返されたみたい…
The Worm Holes#033.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#034.src: I can hear it...but where is it crawling...?
The Worm Holes#034.dst: 聞こえる…でも、どこへ這っていくの…？
The Worm Holes#034.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#035.src: That's the mother Wyrm! She must be what is making the holes. We need to follow her!
The Worm Holes#035.dst: あれは母 Wyrm！穴を開けていたのは彼女ね。追いかけないと！
The Worm Holes#035.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#036.src: Never mind the spiders, we need to keep following the Wyrm!
The Worm Holes#036.dst: 蜘蛛は放っておいて、Wyrm を追い続けないと！
The Worm Holes#036.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#037.src: Ah...ehm, {u}? I've... Um, this is...a bit difficult to say, but...
The Worm Holes#037.dst: あ…ええと、{u}？私… その、これは…少し言いにくいのですが…
The Worm Holes#037.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#038.src: I...do not believe we need to fight, or to kill, here? The creatures are native to here, we are invading their space.
The Worm Holes#038.dst: 私は…ここで戦ったり殺したりする必要はないと思うの。この生き物たちはここの住人で、侵入者は私たちの方なのよ。
The Worm Holes#038.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#039.src: Why should they be attacked for merely existing in their territory? Even if they are animals, I believe that you can solve these problems without killing.
The Worm Holes#039.dst: 自分の縄張りにいるだけで、なぜ攻撃されなきゃいけないの？動物だとしても、殺さずに解決できるはずよ。
The Worm Holes#039.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#040.src: I...understand you may not have the same powers as myself... And I, ah...am not free of guilt, either. But I think you could stand to take a peaceful stance.
The Worm Holes#040.dst: 私…あなたに私と同じ力がないのは分かってる…それに私も、その…罪がないわけじゃない。でも、平和的な立場を取れると思うの。
The Worm Holes#040.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#041.src: Even if I am alone on that front...though I understand you are taught differently where you come from. I do not envy you, though I still thank you for your aid thusfar.
The Worm Holes#041.dst: そう思うのが私だけでも…あなたの故郷では違う教えを受けたのも分かってる。あなたが羨ましいとは思わないけれど、ここまでの助けには感謝してるわ。
The Worm Holes#041.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#042.src: Your methods are...disagreeable, but you still have a sense of right to you, I feel... Well, the tunnel diverges here. We'll need to split apart.
The Worm Holes#042.dst: あなたのやり方は…賛成できない。でも正しさの感覚は持っている気がする…さて、トンネルがここで分かれてる。二手に分かれましょう。
The Worm Holes#042.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#043.src: I'll go to the right, so you ought to continue to the left here. I will meet up with you again soon, hopefully.
The Worm Holes#043.dst: 私は右へ行くから、あなたはここから左へ進んで。すぐにまた合流できるといいけど。
The Worm Holes#043.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#045.dst: ワームのトンネルを調べる。

The Worm Holes#046.src: Aah! {u}! Don't...don't make any sudden movements.
The Worm Holes#046.dst: ああっ！{u}！動か…急に動かないで。
The Worm Holes#046.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#047.src: This Grootslang is uncharacteristically aggressive... She's scared, being so close to the surface. Stay behind me, please.
The Worm Holes#047.dst: この Grootslang、いつになく攻撃的…地表に近すぎて怯えてるの。私の後ろにいて。
The Worm Holes#047.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#049.src: Do not approach it! The power of the Wyrm is far too much for you!
The Worm Holes#049.dst: 近づかないで！Wyrm の力はあなたには強すぎる！
The Worm Holes#049.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#050.dst: ま、また！？[Gavellian Spell]― ああ、どいて！
The Worm Holes#050.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#051.src: {u}!! You're unharmed, yes? She's scared and in pain!
The Worm Holes#051.dst: {u}！！怪我はない？彼女、怯えて苦しんでるの！
The Worm Holes#051.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#052.src: I have to get it right this time... I'm going to talk her down, stay there!
The Worm Holes#052.dst: 今度こそうまくやらなきゃ…彼女をなだめてみる、そこにいて！
The Worm Holes#052.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#053.src: You must be calm, I beg you. Retreat to the earth- You harm those above!
The Worm Holes#053.dst: どうか落ち着いて。土の中へ戻って―上の人々を傷つけているの！
The Worm Holes#053.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#054.src: The earth rotting... I take full responsibility, but does the grass above not rot also?
The Worm Holes#054.dst: 大地が腐っていく…責任はすべて私にある。でも、地上の草だって腐っているでしょう？
The Worm Holes#054.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#055.src: I wish to soothe your pain, but you must allow me to aid you- You must listen!
The Worm Holes#055.dst: あなたの痛みを癒したいの。でも助けさせてくれなきゃ―聞いて！
The Worm Holes#055.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#056.src: What does this violence solve? Be calm, please!
The Worm Holes#056.dst: 暴力で何が解決するの？お願い、落ち着いて！
The Worm Holes#056.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#057.src: {u}, it won't budge... There's something in its mind rejecting me. Distract it- but don't approach! It will kill you if you get close. Just...be loud!
The Worm Holes#057.dst: {u}、びくともしない…心の中の何かが私を拒んでる。気を引いて―でも近づかないで！近づいたら殺される。とにかく…大声を出して！
The Worm Holes#057.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#058.dst: Lari と共に Grootslang と戦う

The Worm Holes#060.src: Can you hear me?! I'll get her to...to...s-something! Spit you up, I don't know! Just...please, d-don't die!
The Worm Holes#060.dst: 聞こえる！？彼女に…何か…な、何とかさせる！吐き出させるとか、分からないけど！だから…お願い、し、死なないで！
The Worm Holes#060.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#061.src: W-We have... We have not laid a blow against you! It is not right for you to do the same!
The Worm Holes#061.dst: わ、私たちは…あなたに一撃も加えていない！同じことをするのは間違ってる！
The Worm Holes#061.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#062.src: You would wound and consume everything in your rage? Even knowing the consequences?
The Worm Holes#062.dst: 怒りに任せて、すべてを傷つけ飲み込むの？結果を分かっていても？
The Worm Holes#062.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#063.src: Your hunger cannot be sated with this fruitless destruction! I beg of you, let them out!
The Worm Holes#063.dst: こんな無益な破壊で飢えは満たせない！お願い、彼らを出してあげて！
The Worm Holes#063.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#064.src: You know th- W-wait...where did you... AAAH!
The Worm Holes#064.dst: 分かって― ま、待って…どこから… きゃああっ！
The Worm Holes#064.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#065.dst: …あ、あなた… …私…ぶ、無事なの？私…*ひっく* 私…
The Worm Holes#065.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#066.src: I tried...w-why does no one listen to me? Why won't a-anything change for me?
The Worm Holes#066.dst: やったのに…ど、どうして誰も聞いてくれないの？どうして私には何も変えられないの？
The Worm Holes#066.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#067.src: She...she's been eating dark parasites. They're wracking her insides and h-hurting her head...
The Worm Holes#067.dst: 彼女…黒い寄生虫を食べていたの。それが体の中を蝕んで、あ、頭を苦しめてる…
The Worm Holes#067.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#068.src: I...i-it's so d-dark... I c-can't breathe... This...th-this can't be the end...
The Worm Holes#068.dst: 私…す、すごく暗い… い、息ができない… こ…これで終わりなんて…
The Worm Holes#068.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#069.src: I...n-no, I can't die in here... I-I'm needed still... You're n-needed still! I... I...
The Worm Holes#069.dst: 私…い、いや、ここで死ねない… ま、まだ必要とされてる… あなたもまだ必要なの！私… 私…
The Worm Holes#069.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#070.src: I n-need... Or... O-Or... C-Concentrate, Lari... You can do this...
The Worm Holes#070.dst: ひ、必要… それとも… そ、それとも… しゅ、集中よ Lari… できるわ…
The Worm Holes#070.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#072.src: LET US OUT! LET US OUT OF HERE! DON'T LET US DIE LIKE THIS! I'M BEGGING YOU, PLEASE!!
The Worm Holes#072.dst: 出して！ここから出して！こんな死に方させないで！お願い、頼むから！！
The Worm Holes#072.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#073.src: ...I...oh no... It's...d-d... I... I j-just... I just w-wanted out... Ohhh...n-no...
The Worm Holes#073.dst: …私…そんな… し、死… わ、私はただ… で、出たかっただけ… ああ…い、いや…
The Worm Holes#073.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#074.src: ...w-we're...leaving. I...I c-can't look at this any more...
The Worm Holes#074.dst: …こ、ここを…出ましょう。私…もうこれ以上見ていられない…
The Worm Holes#074.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#076.src: I'm...I'm so sorry, {u}. If I'd...I don't... I don't even know what else I could have d-done...
The Worm Holes#076.dst: 本当に…本当にごめんなさい、{u}。もし私が…分からない… 他に何ができたのかも、わ、分からない…
The Worm Holes#076.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#077.src: There...it didn’t feel like there was...anything left to it... But, if I’d just been quicker, then... Would it...would it even have made a difference?
The Worm Holes#077.dst: あそこには…もう…何も残っていない気がした… でも、もっと早ければ… 何か…何か変わっていたのかな？
The Worm Holes#077.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#078.src: ...some savior I am... I need to be better, but what else even is there that...ugh, I'm going in circles...
The Worm Holes#078.dst: …何が救世主よ… もっとしっかりしなきゃ、でも他に何が…ああ、堂々巡りだわ…
The Worm Holes#078.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#079.dst: もう… もう行きましょう…
The Worm Holes#079.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#080.src: ...I...I can't believe this. This is...does destiny just hate me? What have I done to deserve this?!
The Worm Holes#080.dst: …私…信じられない。これって…運命は私が嫌いなの？何をしたっていうの！？
The Worm Holes#080.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#081.src: The Mother Wyrm laid eggs... Eggs infested with parasites! Every single one is going to be born berserk!!
The Worm Holes#081.dst: 母 Wyrm が卵を産んでいた… 寄生虫に侵された卵を！全部、狂暴な状態で生まれてくる！！
The Worm Holes#081.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#082.src: You saw how strong the mother was...an infestation like this could cause the entire region of Gavel to collapse in a quake...
The Worm Holes#082.dst: 母親の強さは見たでしょう…こんな蔓延が起きたら、Gavel 全土が地震で崩れてしまうかも…
The Worm Holes#082.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#083.src: They...they need to be stopped, but...I can't do it. I c-can't kill... I'm sorry, I just can't!
The Worm Holes#083.dst: 彼らは…止めなきゃいけない、でも…私にはできない。こ、殺せない… ごめんなさい、どうしても無理なの！
The Worm Holes#083.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#084.src: Bring a group... Even Whelps can be a terror if they're enraged. Just...p-please, take care of this quickly.
The Worm Holes#084.dst: 仲間を連れて行って… 幼体でも怒り狂えば脅威よ。だから…お、お願い、早く片付けて。
The Worm Holes#084.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#085.src: You deserve the best... But that's more than I can give...so here. Take these. I'll move along.
The Worm Holes#085.dst: あなたには最高のお礼がふさわしい… でも私にはこれが精一杯…だから、はい。受け取って。私はもう行くわ。
The Worm Holes#085.speaker: Lari
